entities.name: Njala
entities.description: A valkyrie shepherd of Starnheim who observes battles to judge warriors' worthiness, paired with her reaper sister Alajn.

entities.name: Arni Brokenbrow
entities.description: The red-haired Tuskeri leader, formerly named Goatleaper, whose battles Njala watches.

entities.name: Hormgart
entities.description: A dwarf skald in Starnheim who tells Njala of Arni's past.

entities.name: Tover Giants-Blood
entities.description: A massive duelist who fights Arni in an honor duel.

entities.name: Starnheim
entities.description: The hall of heroes that worthy warriors enter.

entities.name: Feltmark
entities.description: Region above which a skirmish between Skelle and Tuskeri takes place.

entities.name: Skelle
entities.description: Raiders who clash with the Tuskeri.

entities.name: Tusk mountains
entities.description: Mountains where Arni confronts a hellkite dragon.

events.summary: Njala and Alajn watch a skirmish where the outnumbered Tuskeri, led by Arni's bold charge, defeat the Skelle.
events.quote: Despite the odds, Arni led a bold charge, surprising the Skelle and ensuring a Tuskeri victory.

events.summary: Njala feels a strange connection when Arni seems to grin at her.
events.quote: Njala felt a strange connection when Arni appeared to grin at her

events.summary: Njala seeks out Hormgart, who explains how Arni earned the name Brokenbrow headbutting a troll.
events.quote: She sought out Hormgart, a dwarf skald in Starnheim, to learn more about Arni.

events.summary: Arni lassos a hellkite dragon and drives his blade into its skull while Njala and Alajn watch.
events.quote: Arni's cunning prevailed as he lassoed the beast and drove his blade into its skull

events.summary: Arni survives an honor duel with Tover Giants-Blood by headbutting him.
events.quote: Arni employed the same headbutt tactic that won him his name

relations.note: Paired sisters; Alajn is a reaper.
relations.quote: She has a paired sister named Alajn , who serves as a reaper.
the Tuskeri leader known for his red hair and horn-like bone protrusion
